title: Core ambient Hom and evaluation laws
statement: Under the hypotheses of the adic ambient Hom evaluation comparison, the ambient Hom object is bounded constructible, the specified comparison is invertible, postcomposition with it is bijective on every realized test object, and the comparison satisfies transpose, pair-naturality, and evaluation equations.

source.place: BS Lemma 3.4.11 and Remark 6.8.15; first half of the retained seven-step argument

proof.text: The core theorem is assembled from the two strictly smaller named obligations: constructibility and the remaining ambient-adjunction laws.
